matchMode.description: Defaults to exact string equality. array-contains selects an object whose field is an array of strings containing the exact literal; uniqueness is still by original object.

items.description: Complete original objects; at most 32 MiB of compact serialized JSON, no truncation.

field.description: JSON pointer, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; no URI-fragment decoding.

equals.description: Literal comparison value, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

prefix.description: Literal prefix, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; empty is allowed.
